title: Give a field an input
summary: GraphQL: Give a field an input. Ask for twice(n: 7).
introduction: An argument supplies a value to a field. The resolver receives it in an object.
learningObjectives: Give a field an input with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Give a field an input

blocks.text: The argument object gives n value 4. The resolver returns the product 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The input must match the argument type.
